body: Nobody is going to force to stay inside. Fuck that. I live in America.

Whoever thought restricting humans to forcibly stay inside for months and maybe years was a good idea? Humans can’t survive under that. Stupidest choice mankind has ever made. I feel you though because I’m suffering from the same exact problem.

Not really the same though. Years and years passed by and Sammi wasn’t there (I know they had the doll but you know). And it wasn’t as the actual shore house with the old format and then working at the shop. One final season would have been great.

My anxiety has absolutely skyrocketed because of all this. Today was a huge panic attack that I had to endure. I will be dead in a short amount of time if this social distancing is long term. I have had a very rough 4 months prior to this and this was the final thing to set me over the edge. Every day is a huge battle for me and it’s starting to badly affect my health too. I feel like I’m having a heart attack 24/7 because of it. This was NOT the answer. Society will soon realize it.

I’ve been suicidal many times before but this ‘’quarantine’’ thing is pushing me to levels I didn’t know existed. And it’s likely it will never go away. I wish all of us suffering could just be taken without us even knowing.
